name: MagicBokeh native reproduction and Table 3 generator cost
native_input: RGB -> author DAdepth.pth + LDF -> per-image normalized depth -> native LDF median focus
generator: Author FP16 model_test, 512x512 tiles, stride256, original overlap reconstruction, PIL conversion and AdaIN
control: abs(PNG8 predicted depth /255 - native focus) * (K/32); focus mask threshold0.1
efficiency_inputs: Same four first-frame RGBs and K values as configs/efficiency-track-a.json; depth/focus predicted natively, not benchmark geometry
core: Six native generator tile forwards plus author CUDA overlap reconstruction per1024x576 output frame; GPU input/control construction, DAdepth, LDF, transfer, CPU PIL/AdaIN and disk I/O excluded
parameters: Unique learned parameters in actually invoked generator modules, including text encoder; DAdepth and LDF preprocessing parameters excluded with their time
synthetic_status: Not frozen: automatic LDF focus can differ from the benchmark target plane; do not insert a paired quality row yet
scope: Table3 generator cost only, not whole RGB-to-bokeh latency; no claim of temporal modeling or physically equivalent K
